name: number_partitioning_k4_n24_seed1720__v10_nh
prompt:
Partition the integers {1, 2, ..., 24} into 4 disjoint subsets, each summing to the same value 75. (The total sum is 24*(24+1)/2 = 300, so the target is 300/4 = 75.) NP-hard partition problem.

Return a flat list of 24 integers in {0, ..., 3} where the i-th entry (0-indexed) gives the subset assignment of integer i+1. State "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such partition exists.
